## How to read this

**Nothing here decides that a requirement is met.** The strongest claim it makes is that the code *appears* to cover a capability, because a file is named for it or the reading identified it as a component. Whether what exists actually satisfies the requirement is a judgement, and it is yours.

What this does is narrow the judgement. Instead of reading 38 capabilities against a codebase, you read the 38 below that are unclear or absent.

Coverage matters here: this was decided from 3 files read out of 4 in the repository. A capability marked *not found* in a thin reading may simply be somewhere that was not read.
